feature: Resize a group and the pieces inside follow
summary: A group now has the same eight handles a photo has. Drag one and everything inside it moves and grows together, in one undo step, so a card made of a box and a label gets bigger in one gesture instead of piece by piece.
setup: Photonz Dev, Experiments window, release Next, with Layer groups on. Draw a rectangle and a line of text, sweep both with the select tool, then Layer > Group.

try.do: Select the group. It should now show eight square handles, not just a box.
Drag the bottom right handle out and let go.
Look at the label: it moved out with the box but is still the same point size.
Press Command Z once. The whole card should snap back in one step.
Drag the bottom right handle again with Shift held. The card should keep its proportions.
Type 800 into W in Position and Size and press Return. The group should become exactly 800 wide.
Group the card together with something else, then resize the outer group.
Place a copy of a component, select it, and look at W. It says the size comes from the original.

evaluate: When you make a card bigger, do you expect the label to stay the same point size, or to grow with the card?
If you wanted the type to grow too, would you reach for a held key while dragging, or for a separate Scale command?
Does one undo step for a whole group resize feel right, or would you want to undo it piece by piece?
Does the selection box sitting a little below the last line of text after a stretch bother you?
Is refusing to resize a copy of a component clear enough from the note in W, or does it need saying on the canvas?
rough: Text does not re-wrap. Its box scales but the glyphs keep their point size, so shrinking a group a long way can leave a label hanging over its box, and stretching one can leave the selection box sitting below the last line of text. Re-flow is auto layout's job and auto layout is not built yet.

There is no way to scale the type along with the layout. Every design tool has a second gesture for that (Figma calls it the Scale tool). I did not invent one here without asking, since it is a new key to learn.
A group still has no rotate knob. Nothing in the app rotates yet, so that is unchanged rather than missed.

A copy of a component cannot be resized at all: its contents are refilled from its original after every edit, so a stretched copy would snap straight back. Resizing the original works and every copy follows. The W field says so in words.

This changed a written rule. docs/design/ui-building.md used to promise that a group only ever translates, so a measured gap of 12 px stayed 12 px. It now says: grouping never changes a number, but resizing a group changes what is measured, and a caliper inside it reports the new distance.
Verified live in the probe app with Screen Recording granted: the two pictures here are real window captures, not offscreen renders. The walk is Scripts/playtest/group-resize-walk.json.
